title: Stock-and-Flow Bathtub Model
description: Interactive bathtub analogy illustrating stock-and-flow dynamics with an epidemic context — the stock of infected individuals is the water level, β controls the inflow faucet, and γ controls the outflow drain.
creator: Introduction to Public Health
subject: public health
systems thinking
stock and flow
system dynamics
epidemic modeling
learning_objective: Students will be able to explain the integral relationship between flows (β-driven new infections, γ-driven recoveries) and the stock of infected individuals, and identify how a 5-day reporting delay causes the stock to continue rising after true inflow has peaked.
